title.description: The topic of the lecture in a few words

summary.description: What the lecturer explained: 5 to 15 points in time order

t.description: HH:MM:SS copied from a t field of the input

slides.description: One entry for each slide the lecturer talks about, in the order they talk about it

title.description: The title of the slide, or a short one if it has none

explanation.description: Everything the lecturer said about this slide, cleaned of fillers and repetitions: examples, analogies, common mistakes, students' questions and the answers

off_slide.description: One entry for each off_slide element of the input where the lecturer said something that matters

from.description: The same value as the from field in the input

shows.description: What was on screen, in one line

explanation.description: What the lecturer said at that moment, in a clean and complete form

exam.description: Everything about the exam: content the lecturer marks as required, dates, format, allowed materials

quote.description: The lecturer's exact words, copied from the transcript

notices.description: Notices about lectures (cancelled, moved, room), labs, deadlines, office hours, materials, course organization

quote.description: The lecturer's exact words, copied from the transcript

notes.description: Unintelligible or doubtful passages, each with its timestamp
